metadata.flow: Public Self-Service Account Registration & Defaults Seeding

valid_signup.details: Atomically creates business, main branch, owner user, role, Main Cash account, and settings.

email_normalization.details: Uppercase and whitespace email inputs normalized to lowercase.

duplicate_prevention.details: Re-registration with same email in different casing fails validation (422).

initial_cash_structure.details: Main Cash account (CASH-MAIN) seeded with balance 0.00.

initial_settings.details: Receipt header and invoice prefix settings seeded automatically.

token_generation.details: Bearer token issued only after successful transaction commit.
